links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting (ZSL) compared with Chain of Thought (COT) and Talking Out Your Thoughts (TOT) prompting across stroke care stages
links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy, hallucinations, specificity, empathy and actionability of LLM outputs across stroke care stages
links.effect: No numeric values in the abstract. COT was strong in structured reasoning during diagnosis. TOT did well in empathy and actionability. ZSL gave concise, accurate responses with fewer hallucinations, especially in the Treatment stage. None consistently met high clinical standards.
links.quote: Each prompt engineering method showed strengths in specific areas: TOT does well in empathy and actionability, COT was strong in structured reasoning during diagnosis, and ZSL provided concise, accurate responses with fewer hallucinations, especially in the Treatment stage.

design_hint: prompt engineering technique (zero-shot, chain-of-thought, TOT) with expert review
